name: Ideal Hero: Furry Visual Novel
source:
A brave hero (you), is wandering through a fantasy world, with the aim of creating a guild, recruiting various potential warriors.  His great goal is to spread his "Hero's Ideal" around the world, helping people in need.  Could it be that in the midst of so many adventures, maybe there is some time for love?  Only time will tell...

[From Itch.io]
translation:
你将作为一名勇敢的英雄，漫游于奇幻世界，目标是创建公会并招募各路潜在的战士。他的宏愿是把“英雄理想”传播到世界各地，帮助有需要的人。在如此多的冒险之中，是否也能留出一点时间谈场恋爱？只有时间会给出答案……

[来源：Itch.io]
